title: The Fire Triangle
description: Lord Cinder's fires seem unstoppable. Learn the three things every fire needs — and you'll know exactly how to stop them. Earn ember 2!

content.value: For combustion to happen, THREE conditions must all be present at once. Remove any ONE and the fire cannot burn. Together they form the FIRE TRIANGLE.

THE FIRE TRIANGLE
              🔥
             /  \
     FUEL  /      \  OXYGEN (air)
         /          \
        /____________\
        HEAT (to reach ignition temperature)

Remove any ONE side → the fire goes out.

1) FUEL — a substance that can burn (wood, gas, oil). 2) OXYGEN — usually supplied by the air. 3) HEAT — the fuel must be hot enough to catch fire. All three are needed together; miss one and there is no combustion.

The fire triangle is the key to fighting fire. To put a fire OUT, you just have to take away any one of the three sides: remove the fuel, cut off the oxygen, or cool it below its ignition temperature. You'll use this idea in the next module.
Remember the three sides: FUEL, OXYGEN, HEAT. Firefighters win by removing just one side of the triangle — the fire can't survive without all three.
Key Takeaway: Combustion needs three things together — fuel, oxygen, and heat (enough to reach ignition temperature). These form the fire triangle, and removing any one puts the fire out.

quiz.question: The three conditions needed for combustion are fuel, heat, and…
quiz.explain: Combustion needs fuel, oxygen (usually from air) and heat — the fire triangle.

quiz.question: To put out a fire, you need to…
options: add more of all three conditions
remove at least one of the three conditions
quiz.explain: Removing any one side of the fire triangle (fuel, oxygen or heat) stops the fire.

quiz.question: Where does the oxygen for most fires come from?
quiz.explain: Oxygen for combustion usually comes from the air, which is about one-fifth oxygen.
